screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.title: KoHs Inventory Tweaks
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.world_requi: Join a world or server before configuring KoHs Inventory Tweaks.
Inventory and item previews need an active player and the resources loaded for that world.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.subtitle: Tune the behavior, appearance, and scale of your inventory

screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.keybind.des: Click and press a keyboard key. The assignment is also available in Minecraft Controls.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.cursor_land: Choose the exact cursor landing point for each supported inventory.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.inventory_t: Reliability options for fast inventory openings.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.issues_trac: Shows confirmed mod conflicts, affected hooks, and available compatibility handling.
KoHs only reports direct mutation of its internal classes or an exact overwrite of a method it needs. Mods are not flagged merely for adding inventory features.
This mod directly targets internal KoHs Inventory Tweaks classes through a mixin. Its behavior can replace or intercept KoHs logic.
This mod overwrites a Minecraft method used by KoHs. The replacement can remove an injection point required by an inventory feature.
This mod redirects the same required invocation as KoHs. Only one redirect can own that call, so the combination would fail KoHs' mandatory injection check during startup.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.compatibili: A confirmed technical overlap was detected. Remove the listed mod and restart for the safest result, or continue with KoHs guarded compatibility handling. No third-party files or mixins are modified at runtime.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.blocking.in: KoHs Inventory Tweaks requires you to remove the following incompatible mod(s):
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.blocking.re: Reason: This mod and KoHs redirect the same required invocation. Mixin accepts only one redirect there, so KoHs would fail its mandatory injection check and crash startup.
Reason: A required KoHs invocation hook is inside a method overwritten by this mod. Applying both can fail during mixin transformation.
Reason: This mod directly mutates internal KoHs classes before normal initialization.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.blocking.sh: KoHs disabled all of its gameplay mixins and runtime services before they could modify Minecraft. Continuing is blocked. Remove the listed mod(s), then restart Minecraft.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.customizati: Change inventory colors, transparency, and animated backgrounds.
Click to cycle through every Vanilla 26.1.2 inventory surface.

Customization affects every Vanilla container that displays inventory slots: the player inventory, chests, furnaces, workstations, Crafter, storage screens, trading, mounts, Creative inventory, and Bundle slots. Active resource-pack textures are used as the base, then your selected colors, opacity, and background are applied over them.

Install Herzium to access these options.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.herzium.war: Install Herzium before opening these options. Use the Releases page below, place the compatible Herzium build in your mods folder, and restart Minecraft.
Opens a full-screen calibration over the visible world. The inventory is shown at its exact in-game position; move the left slider upward for a larger size or downward for a smaller size.
Actual size: %s%% · preview fitted to this window

Rescaling overrides the vanilla size of the player inventory, including its text, slots, items, and character. The next screen shows its exact in-game position over the visible world. It does not change chests, other containers, or the global GUI scale.

screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.vanilla_cen: Vanilla center · click the preview to customize
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.center_mous: Verifies the custom or vanilla centered position once on open; never drags or continuously forces the cursor.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.super_fast_: Opens instantly, collapses duplicate open requests, and applies one simultaneous offhand press to the slot under the settled cursor.
screen.kohs_inventory_tweaks.remove_anim: Freezes inventory-owned visual motion and removes transient snapback ghost copies without delaying mouse or keyboard input.

Animated GIF or converted-video backgrounds will be held on their first frame. Furnace and brewing progress motion, recipe cycling and bounce, the enchanting book, cycling slot hints, and transient snapback item copies will also be hidden or frozen. This is client-side visual behavior only; container logic, packets, clicks, keys, and transfer speed are unchanged.
